context: Walk Her Home: to the women's residence.

lines.speaker: npc.club_newcomer
lines.text: I just got off the bus Tuesday. Everybody's so fast here.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Here's a token and a number. Rita's bar. Ask for me. Don't ask for anybody else.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Goodnight. Lock the door. Count your money in the morning.
